Starlink Mini USB-C Power Requirements

The Starlink Mini can run from a USB-C PD (Power Delivery) source, but it needs more than a typical phone charger.

Specification

	

Requirement




USB-C PD voltage

	

20V DC




Recommended charger

	

100W USB-C PD




Minimum practical power

	

Approximately 60W, with sufficient startup headroom




Typical power consumption

	

25–40W




USB-C cable

	

100W-rated (5A), with E-marker




Connector at Starlink

	

Proprietary-style DC barrel connector, not USB-C directly

Important: A 65W USB-C charger may work in some conditions, but a 100W PD charger is the safer choice, especially during startup or high power demand.

Official Starlink requirements

Starlink specifies 100W (20V × 5A) minimum for its USB-C cable. A 65W charger is not officially supported, even though the dish itself typically consumes only 20–40W. 
Starlink Help Center
+1

For a power bank, verify that one USB-C port supports 20V/5A output. A power bank advertised as 100W total across multiple ports may not qualify.

Official references: Starlink Mini power requirements and Starlink USB-C cable specifications.
